newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - World Accept EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - World Accept EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co on Thursday reiterated its hold rating on World Acceptance Corp and lowered its estimates for fourth-quarter and fiscal 1997 earnings.
-- Gruntal cut its fourth-quarter estimate to $0.20 a share from $0.29, and cut its fiscal 1997 estimate to $0.45 from $0.58.

-- It said a combination of factors -- including higher interest expense and higher losses -- caused World Acceptance to report lower third quarter earnings. It earned $0.05 a share, versus the year-ago $0.08 and a Gruntal forecast of $0.09.
-- World Acceptance provides short-term loans and credit insurance services.
-- World Acceptance shares were down 11/16 at 5-11/16.
